items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Where was that you were playing? Franklin and Iverville.

ctx.x: They put them in their stocking and reserve.

That's right. Cut the money, put it in their chest. All the paper money is gone a few little quarters. Well, we kept that until they closed down the cabaret. When they closed down the cabaret... Where was that you were playing? Franklin and Iverville. The entertainers.
The entertainers. Yeah. 101, they called it. Well, anyhow.
